verses.original: לַמְנַצֵּ֗חַ מִזְמ֥וֹר לְדָוִֽד׃ בְּךָ֖ יְהוָ֣ה חָ֭סִיתִי אַל־ אֵב֣וֹשָׁה לְעוֹלָ֑ם בְּצִדְקָתְךָ֥ פַלְּטֵֽנִי׃
verses.transliteration: lam·naṣ·ṣê·aḥ miz·mō·wr lə·ḏā·wiḏ bə·ḵā Yah·weh ḥā·sî·ṯî ’al- ’ê·ḇō·wō·šāh lə·‘ō·w·lām bə·ṣiḏ·qā·ṯə·ḵā p̄al·lə·ṭê·nî
verses.literal: For the choirmaster A Psalm of David In You O LORD I have taken refuge let me never . . . be put to shame save me by Your righteousness
verses.literalPt: Em ti, Jeová, me refugio; não seja eu jamais envergonhado. Livra-me na tua retidão.

verses.original: הַטֵּ֤ה אֵלַ֨י׀ אָזְנְךָ֮ מְהֵרָ֪ה הַצִּ֫ילֵ֥נִי הֱיֵ֤ה לִ֨י׀ לְֽצוּר־ מָ֭עוֹז לְבֵ֥ית מְצוּד֗וֹת לְהוֹשִׁיעֵֽנִי׃
verses.transliteration: haṭ·ṭêh ’ê·lay ’ā·zə·nə·ḵā mə·hê·rāh haṣ·ṣî·lê·nî hĕ·yêh lî lə·ṣūr- mā·‘ō·wz lə·ḇêṯ mə·ṣū·ḏō·wṯ lə·hō·wō·šî·‘ê·nî
verses.literal: Incline Your ear to me come quickly to my rescue Be my rock of refuge the stronghold . . . of my deliverance
verses.literalPt: Inclina para mim os teus ouvidos, livra-me depressa. Sê para mim uma rocha fortificada, uma casa de defesa que me salve.

verses.original: כִּֽי־ סַלְעִ֣י וּמְצוּדָתִ֣י אָ֑תָּה וּלְמַ֥עַן שִׁ֝מְךָ֗ תַּֽנְחֵ֥נִי וּֽתְנַהֲלֵֽנִי׃
verses.transliteration: kî- sal·‘î ū·mə·ṣū·ḏā·ṯî ’āt·tāh ū·lə·ma·‘an šim·k̲ā tan·ḥê·nî ū·ṯə·na·hă·lê·nî
verses.literal: For You are my rock and my fortress lead me and guide me for the sake of Your name
verses.literalPt: Porquanto tu és a minha rocha e a minha fortaleza. Por amor do teu nome, me conduzirás e me guiarás.

verses.original: תּוֹצִיאֵ֗נִי מֵרֶ֣שֶׁת ז֭וּ טָ֣מְנוּ לִ֑י כִּֽי־ אַ֝תָּה מָֽעוּזִּֽי׃
verses.transliteration: tō·w·ṣî·’ê·nî mê·re·šeṯ zū ṭā·mə·nū lî kî- ’at·tāh mā·‘ūz·zî
verses.literal: You free me from the net laid out for me for You are my refuge
verses.literalPt: Tirar-me-ás do laço que me armaram às escondidas, pois tu és a minha fortaleza.

verses.original: בְּיָדְךָ֮ אַפְקִ֪יד ר֫וּחִ֥י פָּדִ֖יתָה אוֹתִ֥י יְהוָ֗ה אֵ֣ל אֱמֶֽת׃
verses.transliteration: bə·yā·ḏə·ḵā ’ap̄·qîḏ rū·ḥî pā·ḏî·ṯāh ’ō·w·ṯî Yah·weh ’êl ’ĕ·meṯ
verses.literal: Into Your hands I commit my spirit You have redeemed me O LORD God of truth
verses.literalPt: Nas tuas mãos entrego o meu espírito; tu me remiste, Jeová, Deus de verdade.

verses.original: שָׂנֵ֗אתִי הַשֹּׁמְרִ֥ים הַבְלֵי־ שָׁ֑וְא וַ֝אֲנִ֗י אֶל־ יְהוָ֥ה בָּטָֽחְתִּי׃
verses.transliteration: śā·nê·ṯî haš·šō·mə·rîm haḇ·lê- šāw wa·’ă·nî ’el- Yah·weh bā·ṭā·ḥə·tî
verses.literal: I hate those who cling to worthless idols . . . but in the LORD I trust
verses.literalPt: Aborreço os que observam vaidades mentirosas; eu, porém, confio em Jeová.

verses.original: אָגִ֥ילָה וְאֶשְׂמְחָ֗ה בְּחַ֫סְדֶּ֥ךָ אֲשֶׁ֣ר רָ֭אִיתָ אֶת־ עָנְיִ֑י יָ֝דַ֗עְתָּ בְּצָר֥וֹת נַפְשִֽׁי׃
verses.transliteration: ’ā·ḡî·lāh wə·’eś·mə·ḥāh bə·ḥas·de·ḵā ’ă·šer rā·’î·ṯā ’eṯ- ‘ā·nə·yî yā·ḏa‘·tā bə·ṣā·rō·wṯ nap̄·šî
verses.literal: I will be glad and rejoice in Your loving devotion for You have seen my affliction You have known the anguish of my soul
verses.literalPt: Alegrar-me-ei e regozijar-me-ei na tua benignidade, pois tens visto a minha aflição. Tens conhecido as adversidades da minha alma

verses.original: וְלֹ֣א הִ֭סְגַּרְתַּנִי בְּיַד־ אוֹיֵ֑ב הֶֽעֱמַ֖דְתָּ בַמֶּרְחָ֣ב רַגְלָֽי׃
verses.transliteration: wə·lō his·gar·ta·nî bə·yaḏ- ’ō·w·yêḇ he·‘ĕ·maḏ·tā ḇam·mer·ḥāḇ raḡ·lāy
verses.literal: You have not delivered me to the enemy You have set my feet in the open
verses.literalPt: e não me tens deixado entregue às mãos do inimigo; tens posto os meus pés num lugar espaçoso.

verses.original: חָנֵּ֥נִי יְהוָה֮ כִּ֤י צַ֫ר־ לִ֥י עָשְׁשָׁ֖ה בְכַ֥עַס עֵינִ֗י נַפְשִׁ֥י וּבִטְנִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: ḥān·nê·nî Yah·weh kî ṣar- lî ‘ā·šə·šāh ḇə·ḵa·‘as ‘ê·nî nap̄·šî ū·ḇiṭ·nî
verses.literal: Be merciful to me O LORD for I am in distress my eyes fail from sorrow my soul and body as well
verses.literalPt: Compadece-te de mim, porque me sinto atribulado; os meus olhos estão consumidos de tristeza, sim, a minha alma e o meu corpo.

verses.original: כִּ֤י כָל֪וּ בְיָג֡וֹן חַיַּי֮ וּשְׁנוֹתַ֪י בַּאֲנָ֫חָ֥ה כָּשַׁ֣ל בַּעֲוֺנִ֣י כֹחִ֑י וַעֲצָמַ֥י עָשֵֽׁשׁוּ׃
verses.transliteration: kî ḵā·lū ḇə·yā·ḡō·wn ḥay·yay ū·šə·nō·w·ṯay ba·’ă·nā·ḥāh kā·šal ba·‘ă·wō·nî ḵō·ḥî wa·‘ă·ṣā·may ‘ā·šê·šū
verses.literal: For my life is consumed with grief and my years with groaning my iniquity has drained my strength and my bones are wasting away
verses.literalPt: Pois está gasta de pesar a minha vida, e, de suspirar, os meus anos; por causa da minha iniquidade, desfalece a minha força, e consumidos estão os meus ossos.

verses.original: מִכָּל־ צֹרְרַ֨י הָיִ֪יתִי חֶרְפָּ֡ה וְלִשֲׁכֵנַ֨י׀ מְאֹד֮ וּפַ֪חַד לִֽמְיֻדָּ֫עָ֥י רֹאַ֥י בַּח֑וּץ נָדְד֥וּ מִמֶּֽנִּי׃
verses.transliteration: mik·kāl ṣō·rə·ray hā·yî·ṯî ḥer·pāh wə·li·šă·ḵê·nay mə·’ōḏ ū·p̄a·ḥaḏ lim·yud·dā·‘āy rō·’ay ba·ḥūṣ nā·ḏə·ḏū mim·men·nî
verses.literal: Among all my enemies I am a disgrace and among my neighbors even more I am dreaded by my friends they flee when they see me on the street
verses.literalPt: Por causa de todos os meus adversários, tornei-me um opróbrio, sim, sobremodo o sou para os meus vizinhos e horror para os meus conhecidos. Os que me viam na rua fugiam de mim.

verses.original: נִ֭שְׁכַּחְתִּי כְּמֵ֣ת מִלֵּ֑ב הָ֝יִ֗יתִי כִּכְלִ֥י אֹבֵֽד׃
verses.transliteration: niš·kaḥ·tî kə·mêṯ mil·lêḇ hā·yî·ṯî kiḵ·lî ’ō·ḇêḏ
verses.literal: I am forgotten like a dead man out of mind I am like a broken vessel
verses.literalPt: Sou esquecido como um morto posto fora do pensamento, sou como um vaso quebrado.

verses.original: כִּ֤י שָׁמַ֨עְתִּי׀ דִּבַּ֥ת רַבִּים֮ מָג֪וֹר מִסָּ֫בִ֥יב בְּהִוָּסְדָ֣ם יַ֣חַד עָלַ֑י לָקַ֖חַת נַפְשִׁ֣י זָמָֽמוּ׃
verses.transliteration: kî šā·ma‘·tî dib·baṯ rab·bîm mā·ḡō·wr mis·sā·ḇîḇ bə·hiw·wā·sə·ḏām ya·ḥaḏ ‘ā·lay lā·qa·ḥaṯ nap̄·šî zā·mā·mū
verses.literal: For I hear the slander of many there is terror on every side They conspire . . . against me and plot to take my life
verses.literalPt: Pois tenho ouvido a difamação de muitos, terror por todos os lados. Enquanto juntamente consultavam contra mim, maquinaram para me tirar a vida.

verses.original: וַאֲנִ֤י׀ עָלֶ֣יךָ בָטַ֣חְתִּי יְהוָ֑ה אָ֝מַ֗רְתִּי אֱלֹהַ֥י אָֽתָּה׃
verses.transliteration: wa·’ă·nî ‘ā·le·ḵā ḇā·ṭaḥ·tî Yah·weh ’ā·mar·tî ’ĕ·lō·hay ’āt·tāh
verses.literal: But I trust in You O LORD I say You are my God
verses.literalPt: Quanto a mim, porém, em ti confio, Jeová. Eu disse: Tu és meu Deus.

verses.original: בְּיָדְךָ֥ עִתֹּתָ֑י הַצִּ֘ילֵ֤נִי מִיַּד־ א֝וֹיְבַ֗י וּמֵרֹדְפָֽי׃
verses.transliteration: bə·yā·ḏə·ḵā ‘it·tō·ṯāy haṣ·ṣî·lê·nî mî·yaḏ- ’ō·wy·ḇay ū·mê·rō·ḏə·p̄āy
verses.literal: My times are in Your hands deliver me from my enemies and from those who pursue me
verses.literalPt: Na tua mão estão os meus dias; livra-me das mãos dos meus inimigos e dos que me perseguem.

verses.original: הָאִ֣ירָה פָ֭נֶיךָ עַל־ עַבְדֶּ֑ךָ ה֖וֹשִׁיעֵ֣נִי בְחַסְדֶּֽךָ׃
verses.transliteration: hā·’î·rāh p̄ā·ne·ḵā ‘al- ‘aḇ·de·ḵā hō·wō·šî·‘ê·nî ḇə·ḥas·de·ḵā
verses.literal: Make Your face shine on Your servant save me by Your loving devotion
verses.literalPt: Faze brilhar o teu rosto sobre o teu servo; salva-me na tua benignidade.

verses.original: יְֽהוָ֗ה אַל־ אֵ֭בוֹשָׁה כִּ֣י קְרָאתִ֑יךָ יֵבֹ֥שׁוּ רְ֝שָׁעִ֗ים יִדְּמ֥וּ לִשְׁאֽוֹל׃
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh ’al- ’ê·ḇō·wō·šāh kî qə·rā·ṯî·ḵā yê·ḇō·šū rə·šā·‘îm yid·də·mū liš·’ō·wl
verses.literal: O LORD let me not be ashamed for I have called on You Let the wicked be put to shame let them lie silent in Sheol
verses.literalPt: Não seja eu envergonhado, Jeová, porque te hei invocado; envergonhados sejam os iníquos, fiquem mudos no Sheol.

verses.original: תֵּ֥אָלַ֗מְנָה שִׂפְתֵ֫י שָׁ֥קֶר הַדֹּבְר֖וֹת עַל־ צַדִּ֥יק עָתָ֗ק בְּגַאֲוָ֥ה וָבֽוּז׃
verses.transliteration: tê·’ā·lam·nāh śip̄·ṯê šā·qer had·dō·ḇə·rō·wṯ ‘al- ṣad·dîq ‘ā·ṯāq bə·ḡa·’ă·wāh wā·ḇūz
verses.literal: May lying lips be silenced lips that speak with arrogance against the righteous full of pride and contempt
verses.literalPt: Emudeçam os lábios mentirosos, que falam insolentemente contra o justo, com orgulho e desprezo.

verses.original: מָ֤ה רַֽב־ טוּבְךָ֮ אֲשֶׁר־ צָפַ֪נְתָּ לִּֽירֵ֫אֶ֥יךָ פָּ֭עַלְתָּ לַחֹסִ֣ים בָּ֑ךְ נֶ֝֗גֶד בְּנֵ֣י אָדָם׃
verses.transliteration: māh raḇ- ṭū·ḇə·ḵā ’ă·šer- ṣā·p̄an·tā lî·rê·’e·ḵā pā·‘al·tā la·ḥō·sîm bāḵ ne·ḡeḏ bə·nê ʾå̄·ḏå̄m
verses.literal: How great is Your goodness which You have laid up for those who fear You which You have bestowed before the sons of men on those who take refuge in You
verses.literalPt: Oh! Quão grande é a tua bondade, que reservaste para os que te temem, a qual, perante os filhos dos homens, preparaste para aqueles que em ti se refugiam!

verses.original: תַּסְתִּירֵ֤ם׀ בְּסֵ֥תֶר פָּנֶיךָ֮ מֵֽרֻכְסֵ֫י אִ֥ישׁ תִּצְפְּנֵ֥ם בְּסֻכָּ֗ה מֵרִ֥יב לְשֹׁנֽוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: tas·tî·rêm bə·sê·ṯer pā·ne·ḵā mê·ruḵ·sê ’îš tiṣ·pə·nêm bə·suk·kāh mê·rîḇ lə·šō·nō·wṯ
verses.literal: You hide them in the secret place of Your presence from the schemes of men You conceal them in Your shelter from accusing tongues
verses.literalPt: No lugar oculto da tua presença, tu os esconderás das tramas dos homens; num pavilhão, os ocultarás da contenda de línguas.

verses.original: בָּר֥וּךְ יְהוָ֑ה כִּ֥י הִפְלִ֘יא חַסְדּ֥וֹ לִ֝֗י בְּעִ֣יר מָצֽוֹר׃
verses.transliteration: bā·rūḵ Yah·weh kî hip̄·lî ḥas·dōw lî bə·‘îr mā·ṣō·wr
verses.literal: Blessed be the LORD for He has shown me His loving devotion in a city under siege
verses.literalPt: Bendito seja Jeová, porque tem feito maravilhosa a sua benignidade para comigo numa cidade fortificada!

verses.original: וַאֲנִ֤י׀ אָ֘מַ֤רְתִּי בְחָפְזִ֗י נִגְרַזְתִּי֮ מִנֶּ֪גֶד עֵ֫ינֶ֥יךָ אָכֵ֗ן שָׁ֭מַעְתָּ ק֥וֹל תַּחֲנוּנַ֗י בְּשַׁוְּעִ֥י אֵלֶֽיךָ׃
verses.transliteration: wa·’ă·nî ’ā·mar·tî ḇə·ḥā·p̄ə·zî niḡ·raz·tî min·ne·ḡeḏ ‘ê·ne·ḵā ’ā·ḵên šā·maʿ·tā qō·wl ta·ḥă·nū·nay bə·šaw·wə·‘î ’ê·le·ḵā
verses.literal: In my alarm I said I am cut off from Your sight But You heard my plea for mercy when I called to You for help
verses.literalPt: Quanto a mim, porém, disse em meu sobressalto: Estou cortado de diante dos teus olhos. Não obstante, ouviste a voz das minhas súplicas quando a ti clamava por socorro.

verses.original: אֶֽהֱב֥וּ אֶת־ יְהוָ֗ה כָּֽל־ חֲסִ֫ידָ֥יו אֱ֭מוּנִים נֹצֵ֣ר יְהוָ֑ה וּמְשַׁלֵּ֥ם עַל־ יֶ֝֗תֶר עֹשֵׂ֥ה גַאֲוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ’e·hĕ·ḇū ’eṯ- Yah·weh kāl- ḥă·sî·ḏāw ’ĕ·mū·nîm nō·ṣêr Yah·weh ū·mə·šal·lêm ‘al- ye·ṯer ‘ō·śêh ḡa·’ă·wāh
verses.literal: Love the LORD all His saints The LORD preserves the faithful but fully . . . repays the arrogant . . .
verses.literalPt: Amai a Jeová, vós todos os que sois seus santos. Jeová preserva os que são fiéis e retribui abundantemente ao que usa de soberba.

verses.original: חִ֭זְקוּ וְיַאֲמֵ֣ץ לְבַבְכֶ֑ם כָּל־ הַ֝מְיַחֲלִ֗ים לַיהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ḥiz·qū wə·ya·’ă·mêṣ lə·ḇaḇ·ḵem kāl- ham·ya·ḥă·lîm Yah·weh
verses.literal: Be strong and courageous . . . all you who hope in the LORD
verses.literalPt: Sede fortes, e fortaleça-se o vosso coração, vós todos os que esperais em Jeová.
